title: (LEAD) Up to 125,000 gather in Seoul's Hongdae area on Halloween; 30,000 in Itaewon: data
caption:
Real-time data from the Seoul government shows a massive shift in Halloween crowds. While Hongdae surged to 125,000 people, Itaewon remained significantly quieter as the city prioritizes safety and remembrance.

Source: En - (LEAD) Up to 125,000 gather in Seoul's Hongdae area on Halloween; 30,000 in Itaewon: data
